payload.label: Auction Display Amount (USD)
payload.description: Amount sampled from an auction broadcast display instrument. Source property distinguishes overlay from physical board; typed presentation/publication and source media clocks determine context. Not an accepted bid, asking price, hammer price or final price.

new_properties.reader: Event fold retains instruments separately. Existing vehicle_canonical latest-per-property view cannot substitute for presentation market-state replay.

payload.label: Announced Auction High Bid (USD)
payload.description: Literal announced high-bid amount claimed in broadcast language. Keep no-sale/reserve/outcome distinct and provenance attached to the typed presentation. Not a sold or premium-inclusive price.

new_properties.reader: Claim source readback by presentation; no authoritative event high_bid/winning_bid overwrite.

unit_blockers.required: A separately cited conversion projection or a reviewed source-unit property; never bind 427 to a liters property.
